baseline_models.focus_anchor: ءامنوا بالله ورسله ... الصديقون والشهداء عند ربهم
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settling assent receives a carried message, realizes it in action, and becomes knowledgeable testimony. Nearness to the Lord supplies the validating forum, while light makes that fidelity manifest and orienting.

activation_trace.role: Settled confirmation supplies the inward reception that begins the sequence.
The messenger and carried message give assent a transmitted object.
Realizing a promise in deed turns assent into verified fidelity.
Knowledge-based declaration makes verified fidelity outwardly attestable.
Proximity and presence locate the testimony before its validating Lord.
A visible waymark renders the validated fidelity orienting for movement.

changed_reading.before: Believers receive two honorific titles and a reward.
changed_reading.after: Belief is a conversion of received message into enacted truth and inspectable witness, validated near the Lord and issued as orientation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نورهم ... كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا ... أصحاب الجحيم
baseline_models.mechanism: The two cohorts perform inverse operations on evidence: truth and witness disclose, while covering and falsifying suppress visible marks. Illumination answers disclosure; persistent companionship with a fully kindled environment answers sustained suppression.

activation_trace.role: A witness can itself function as a sign that makes a condition legible.
Illumination is the positive outcome of making evidence visible.
Covering supplies the material inverse of disclosure.
Contradicting truth supplies the verbal inverse of truthful realization.
The denied objects are visible marks, so the failure concerns evidence rather than mere group identity.
Companionship converts a verdict into an abiding relation.
Intensely kindled heat is the enduring environment paired with concealment.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts rewarded believers with punished unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: It contrasts two ways of handling evidence: embodied disclosure produces orientation, whereas covering and falsifying visible signs hardens into an abiding contrary environment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: هم الصديقون ۖ والشهداء عند ربهم لهم أجرهم ونورهم
baseline_models.mechanism: The emphatic first predicate supports one unified class, but the pause and the fresh coordination before witnesses also permit a separately foregrounded witness-clause. Nearness, reward, and light can therefore qualify both titles together or especially the witness group without forcing a single parse.

activation_trace.role: Completed firmness supports الصديقون as a self-standing achieved status.
Presence with observation lets الشهداء begin a distinct presence-centered clause.
Nearness can attach locally to the witness phrase or extend over the coordinated predicates.
Recompense provides a shared outcome even if the titles retain separate profiles.
Shared illumination can close either the local witness clause or the larger coordinated description.

changed_reading.before: All believers are flattened into one class bearing two interchangeable labels.
changed_reading.after: Two readings remain live: believers bear both truth and witness predicates, or witnesses receive separate foregrounding near their Lord while sharing the reward-light horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah's signs and light become endpoints of one process: disclosed signs effect an exit from an enclosing condition into illumination. Denial therefore blocks a transformation, while their light is the realized effect of receptive evidence-handling rather than an unrelated prize.

activation_trace.role: Visible marks anchor the input that the negative cohort rejects.
Their illumination anchors the positive endpoint in the focus ayah.
Visible marks recur as the supplied instrument of change.
Disclosure by speech or sign makes the marks operationally clear.
Passage to the outside supplies the transition performed through those signs.
Illumination is the explicit destination of the transition.

structural_cues: 57:9 gives the purpose sequence clear signs -> bring you out of darkness -> light; 57:19 places denial of signs opposite possession of light.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered purpose construction; I carry its causal arrow into 57:19. A live alternative is that نورهم is solely later recompense, not the matured effect of signs in the present.

changed_reading.before: Light is a reward placed beside wages after belief.
changed_reading.after: Light is also what successfully received signs do: they extract and orient, so denying signs is refusal of the very process that would generate illumination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding root sequence binds صدق to relinquishing a loan whose return is multiplied and named أجر. This materializes صديق-status as truth proved by releasing held resources and trusting return, not only correct speech.

activation_trace.role: Fulfilled action anchors truthfulness as something realized rather than merely asserted.
Recompense anchors the focus ayah's return for enacted fidelity.
The charity branch makes the adjacent صدق-family expression materially distributive.
Cutting off wealth or work for returned recompense supplies the risk-and-return mechanism.
Increase by a like amount makes the entrusted release generative rather than merely lost.
The same work-return image closes the context mechanism and reappears in the focus ayah.

structural_cues: 57:18 places the صدق-family agents, a good loan, multiplication, and noble recompense in one sentence immediately before الصديقون and أجرهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, shared roots, and the loan-return sequence; I infer deliberate pressure from the charitable form onto صديقون. The live alternative is that صديقون retains a broader truth-confirming sense with no special economic force.

changed_reading.before: The truthful are chiefly people of unusually sincere assertion.
changed_reading.after: Their truth can be audited materially: they release what they hold on trust, and أجر names the returned value of that enacted fidelity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The possessed light in 57:19 becomes mobile capacity: it runs ahead, an excluded group unsuccessfully seeks to take it from others, and it is given for walking. نورهم is thus personalized orientation accumulated before the moment of need, not static ornament transferable on demand.

activation_trace.role: A visible waymark anchors light as personal orientation in the focus ayah.
Purposeful motion makes the believers' light advance toward a required destination.
Their illumination is explicitly the moving subject.
Seeking light or good from another supplies the attempted transfer that the scene refuses.
Repeated illumination marks both the requested possession and the unavailable substitute.
The waymark image becomes an expressly granted means of orientation.
Walking supplies the concrete use for the granted light.

structural_cues: The possessive نورهم recurs across 57:12-13; the borrowing request fails after separation, and 57:28 states that light is for walking by.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies motion, attempted borrowing, and walking; I infer that recurrence defines the function of نورهم in 57:19. A live alternative is ceremonial radiance that accompanies, rather than enables, movement.

changed_reading.before: Their light is a visible badge of reward.
changed_reading.after: Their light is a nonfungible capacity to find and traverse a way; its possession records prior alignment and cannot be improvised by proximity to someone else's light.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger complex later joins disclosed proofs, a book, and a balance to the purpose that people rise for equity. Read back into الشهداء, knowledgeable testimony is not passive seeing: it makes the message publicly measurable and socially operative.

activation_trace.role: The carried message anchors what the focus witnesses receive and attest.
Knowledge-based declaration anchors the title's evidentiary function.
Repeated messenger and message language frames the public-purpose sequence.
Disclosure by sign supplies publicly inspectable proof.
The balance of justice turns testimony into a standard for comparison.
Rising resolutely makes the people active bearers of the standard.
Equity and fair dealing name the social result that messenger-evidence is to produce.

structural_cues: 57:25 explicitly gives the book-and-balance complex a purpose clause: that people stand for equity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the messenger, proof, measure, standing, and equity sequence; I map its public evidentiary role onto الشهداء. The title can alternatively remain eschatological witness, martyr, or honorific without this institutional emphasis.

changed_reading.before: The witnesses are observers or bearers of an elevated title.
changed_reading.after: They are agents who make received truth publicly testable by standing up a just measure in collective life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plural messengers in the focus ayah expands into a trace-chain: messenger follows remaining mark, followers track that chain, yet an inherited practice can still fail through deficient care. Belief in His messengers therefore includes discriminating continuity and custody, not bare historical affiliation.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups make the plural messengers available as a transmitted chain.
Following a trace in succession supplies the chain's directional structure.
A remaining mark carries evidence of what preceded it.
The messenger recurrence fills the successive positions in that trace.
Tracking mark after mark describes the follower's side of transmission.
Preserving and tending an obligation supplies the criterion by which inherited following succeeds or fails.

structural_cues: 57:27 repeats following language around traces and messengers, then contrasts inventing a discipline with failure to tend it as it deserved.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, traces, following, and failed tending; I infer a custody criterion for the focus phrase ورسله. A live alternative is that 57:27 narrates one later community without defining belief in the messenger plurality.

changed_reading.before: Belief in His messengers means accepting a list of authorized individuals.
changed_reading.after: It also means inhabiting a diachronic evidence-chain: follow preserved traces, carry the message onward, and test inherited forms by faithful care rather than pedigree alone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The agrarian branch is surprising because كفر in 57:19 ordinarily names unbelief and 57:20 can call unbelievers الكفار. It remains live because the packet supplies the same root's seed-covering branch inside an explicit rain-crop-decay analogy immediately after the focus ayah. Render only as a material analogy for concealment and investment, not as a replacement gloss.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed gives focus denial a deliberately distant material model of burying what could disclose life.
Visible marks are what the model says are buried beneath fascination with surface yield.
The farmers who cover seed make the agrarian branch locally visible in the crop simile.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the transient visible yield that fascinates the cultivator.
The world's vanishing debris supplies the collapse of that surface investment.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is only abstract rejection of propositions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is failed cultivation: signs are covered like seed, but attention fixes on impressive transient growth until it dries into debris instead of yielding durable recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because reward-light and punitive fire must not be collapsed. It remains anchored because the packet maps both نور and the contextual نار to the same root inventory, whose branches include illumination and kindled fire, while the focus ends in blazing جحيم. Render as a controlled contrast within one energy/visibility field, never as an identity of outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the possessed, guiding pole of the field.
The contextual fire activates the same inventory's kindled-fire pole shortly before the focus ayah.
Abiding companionship marks the negative pole as an environment that holds its cohort.
Fully kindled heat specifies the consuming rather than guiding outcome.

changed_reading.before: Reward-light and hellfire are unrelated images placed on opposite sides.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, one visibility-and-energy field bifurcates: received truth becomes light one can possess and walk by, while rejected truth ends as a blaze whose companions cannot leave.

strongest_changes: 57:9 turns signs and light into a causal transformation rather than separate motifs.
57:18 makes صديق-status materially auditable through entrusted giving and returned recompense.
57:12-13 and 57:28 turn نورهم into personal, nonborrowable mobility.
57:25 and 57:27 expand witness and messenger-belief into public equity and diachronic custody.
summary.what_was_special: The compact focus contrast opened into mechanisms of evidence handling: signs disclose, truth is enacted, testimony establishes measure, and light enables movement. Distant but packet-licensed branches also exposed contained agricultural and light/fire readings that a conservative synthesis could miss.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether والشهداء begins a separately foregrounded clause or shares the predicate structure of الصديقون.
How strongly the charitable form in 57:18 should constrain the broader صديقون in 57:19.
Whether نورهم names present transformation, eschatological equipment, or both.
Whether the agrarian كفر and نور/نار branch crossings are intended local wordplay or only productive material analogies.
